title: Chapter 594
text:
In the middle of the Sol Cluster …

The stars shone brightly, and a stream of light streaked across the universe, traversing through the darkness. It was the Blacklight Stealth. Only Han Xiao, Ames, and Hella were on board.

After many days of travel, they finally arrived at Sol from Colton. During this period, they had passed through many Star Systems through many teleportation stargates. At the stargate that Colton used to jump to Sol, they were even interrogated by the stargate station.

The Klent Kingdom had strict management of the Sol Cluster, and there were checkpoints set up at the stargates that crossed Star Clusters.

The entry stargate crossed the desolate universe belt between two star clusters, saving a lot of time. Interstellar travelers with clean backgrounds would use the stargate. Those who walked through the desolate universe belt were mostly wanted criminals and some unspeakable forces. It was like illegal immigration.

The Bloodshed Land's headquarters was located in a Star System controlled by the Klent Kingdom, which was also the core Star System in the middle of the Sol Cluster.

In the hall, Han Xiao looked at the location of the Bloodshed Land's headquarters on the star map and curled his lips.

"Planet Heber, tsk, to actually name their headquarters after themselves, seriously …" Han Xiao was just about to comment when he suddenly remembered that he had done the same thing. He immediately changed his words. "Great minds think alike!"

"Are we almost there?" Aurora looked at the star map curiously and realized that she could not understand it.

"The hyperdrive will end in about ten minutes and twenty-seven seconds." Han Xiao looked at the interface that Risda had given him. The spaceship was now in autopilot mode, and the four of them were in the hall of the spaceship.

"Teacher, is Planet Heber similar to Floating Dragon Island?" Aurora turned around and asked.

Ames was lying on the sofa with a noble and lazy temperament. She smiled and said, "It's not the same. Planet Heber is much more expensive. It's an artificially modified planet built by the Klent Kingdom with the technology of a Star Cluster Civilization. It's more like a moving fortress, the second most powerful weapon in Heber's hands."

The ability of a Star Cluster Civilization far exceeded that of a Star System Civilization. The most obvious difference was their mobility. A Star Cluster Civilization could build a teleportation stargate, and the distance they could move in the universe was countless times that of a Star System Civilization.

At the same time, the Star Cluster Civilizations also had the technology to build planet-level battleships. The most common model was the planet-level mining mothership, which directly 'ate' a planet and split it into various resources.

Planet Heber was a planetary class bastion built by the Klent Federation.

"Second strongest? What's the Tyrant's strongest weapon? "Hella asked with a serious expression. She was more interested in the abilities of the strongest people in the Shattered Star Ring.

"His strongest weapon is, of course, his own body." Ames shook her head. "He can use his physical body to directly penetrate a planet."

"How is this possible!" Aurora exclaimed.

Han Xiao asked Philip to search for Heber's achievements. There was more than one record of him penetrating a planet. It was almost a routine for Heber.

"Heber's body is extremely strong. Soil and rocks can't stop him, and the dense rock layers deep underground are like paper in front of him. Magma is his bathwater, and the temperature of a planet's core is not high enough to burn him. Maybe a star can hurt him, but a planet can't. Therefore, colliding with a planet is not much of a challenge for him." Ames sighed.

Heber was almost her nemesis. Even the strongest force field could not tear Heber apart. Heber could move freely even under the pressure. Even if she used Floating Dragon Island to collide with him, it would be shattered by Heber's Iron Head Technique. The natural enemy of force field Esper Abilities was this kind of indestructible enemy. After all, although force field Esper Abilities were all-rounded, they were more focused on control. Relatively speaking, killing power was not the strong point.

Although Ames did things as she pleased, she was not without self-awareness. She was clear about her own weaknesses.

"…" Hella frowned and fell silent. Heber's strength had temporarily exceeded her understanding, and she did not know what to say.

"Heber penetrates a planet through a single point, just like how a sniper bullet penetrates several layers of wood." Han Xiao shook his head. A Beyond Grade A Pugilist was truly terrifying.

After chatting for a while, the BlackLight Stealth finally exited its hyperdrive state. The tunnel of light outside the porthole disappeared, and they returned to the universe.

Just below the spaceship, a small iron-gray planet came into view. Its color was eerie and heavy.

Planet Heber!

Han Xiao received a communication request from Planet Heber. If he did not verify his identity and rashly stayed near Planet Heber, he would be treated as an enemy.

Ames had the invitation letter, and after verifying her identity, Planet Heber sent the coordinates to stop at. Han Xiao then got Risda to control the spaceship and fly toward the designated landing location.

Because Planet Heber was a moving fortress, just like Floating Dragon Island, it was in a moving state all year round. Thus, there was no natural sunlight, and the sky was covered with thick, man-made black clouds to weaken the cosmic radiation.

The spaceship slowly descended, and after passing through the black clouds, they could see the surface of Planet Heber in detail.

Planet Heber was mainly cold and dark, and there was almost nothing fancy about it.

There were towering castle-like buildings, and the bases were like continuous mountain ranges. These buildings glowed with faint blue light, giving them a futuristic, mysterious, and technologically advanced feeling. Among the bases, there were some large hollow ring devices that were sparsely distributed. They were one to two thousand meters tall, and the hollow rings were shining with a purple light. They were moving like ripples, as though they were doing something.

In the sky above the bases, battleships were patrolling in groups.

This was a planet-level armed fortress!

Hella and Aurora could not help but gasp in amazement.

The Blacklight Stealth landed at the dock between the bases, and they walked out of the spaceship. They saw a group of people already waiting there. They were all Bloodshed Land soldiers, and the leader was Vanguard Official Malekith.

"Your Excellency Dragon Emperor, thank you for accepting the invitation. Welcome to Bloodshed Land."

Malekith gave a bow. He was the one who had personally sent Ames the invitation letter.

Ames did not comment. She looked at the surroundings, smiled, and said, "I haven't been here for a long time, and this place is still as boring as ever. Heber is really tasteless."

"Battleships and fortresses are the best decorations," Malekith replied.

Malekith then saw Han Xiao beside Ames. His eyes flashed, and he calmly said, "Black Star, as I said, we will meet again very soon."

Han Xiao raised his brows, acted dumb, and said, "Who are you? I have never seen you before. "

"…"

Everyone looked over and stared at him.

"Alright, I was just joking." Han Xiao grinned.

The people of Bloodshed Land were really interesting, trying to sow discord the moment they met. Malekith purposely used such an ambiguous way to imply that he had met Black Star in private.

Han Xiao did not tell Ames that he had come into contact with Malekith, and Ames had been poached before, so she should be very sensitive to this. If she knew that her capable officer had met with Bloodshed Land in private again, she would probably not be nice to Han Xiao.

Malekith looked like a barbarian with a bad brain, but it turned out that he had a dirty heart.

Alright, I will remember this grudge.

—
